mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail ( sender_id, subject, content, send_time, has_attachment, is_spam, priority, mail_status, sender_deleted ) VALUES ( #{senderId}, #{subject}, #{content}, NOW(), #{hasAttachment}, #{spam}, #{priority}, #{mailStatus}, #{senderDeleted} )
INSERT INTO mail_receiver ( mail_id, receiver_id, receiver_type, is_read, is_deleted, receive_time ) VALUES ( #{mailId}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverType}, #{read}, #{deleted}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(m.content, '')) > 50 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.content, 50), '...') ELSE m.content END AS preview, mr.is_read, m.has_attachment, mr.receive_time, m.send_time, m.priority, m.is_spam FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN mail m ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.receiver_id = #{userId} AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1 ORDER BY m.send_time DESC

SELECT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(m.content, '')) > 50 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.content, 50), '...') ELSE m.content END AS preview, m.has_attachment, m.send_time, m.priority, m.is_spam FROM mail m JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1 ORDER BY m.send_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(m.content, '')) > 50 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.content, 50), '...') ELSE m.content END AS preview, mr.is_read, m.has_attachment, mr.receive_time, m.send_time, m.priority, m.is_spam FROM mail m JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN mail_receiver mr ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id = #{userId} WHERE m.mail_status = 1 AND ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = TRUE) OR mr.is_deleted = TRUE ) ORDER BY m.send_time DESC

SELECT u.username FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type IN ('TO', 'CC') ORDER BY FIELD(mr.receiver_type, 'TO', 'CC'), u.email

SELECT u.email FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type IN ('TO', 'CC') ORDER BY FIELD(mr.receiver_type, 'TO', 'CC'), u.email

SELECT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username AS sender_name, u.email AS sender_email, m.subject, m.content, m.send_time, m.has_attachment, m.priority, m.is_spam, sr.spam_type, sr.reason FROM mail m JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN spam_record sr ON sr.mail_id = m.mail_id WHERE m.mail_id = #{mailId} AND m.mail_status = 1
SELECT u.email FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type = 'TO' ORDER BY u.email
SELECT u.email FROM mail_receiver mr JOIN `user` u ON mr.receiver_id = u.user_id WHERE mr.mail_id = #{mailId} AND mr.receiver_type = 'CC' ORDER BY u.email
